Youth presenters wanted! 
Cinekid is looking for film fanatics between 16 and 20 years old from (the) Amsterdam (area) to introduce films and supervise Q&As during Cinekid Festival 2026. Youth presenters wanted! 
Are you a cinema lover, have you seen everything on Netflix or do you have the sharpest analyses on your friends' TikToks? Do you enjoy being in front of an audience to act or present, for example? Then become a youth presenter during Cinekid Festival 2026! 
Cinekid is thé media- and film festival of the Netherlands. Here you can attend the coolest workshops and watch the best children's films. It doesn't stop there: after a selection of film screenings, a Q&A takes place. This is an after-screening where a guest is invited for an interview. Among others directors and film stars who are only too happy to tell you the most interesting and funniest facts about their film. 
 What does a youth presenter do? 
As a presenter, you are responsible for introducing the films and leading the Q&As afterwards. In the introduction, you welcome the audience in the room and introduce the film they will be watching. During the Q&As, you will talk to the filmmakers and/or actors of the film and ask them questions! You will also coordinate questions from the audience. You can work as a presenter on your own, but we usually assign you in pairs. You can also invite a friend! 
 Who are you? 
 - You speak Dutch - You enjoy being in front of a (large) audience - You live in (the vicinity of) Amsterdam - As presenter, you are available for at least 3 days between 10 October and 16 October 2026 - Prior to the festival, you will get a training. More info on this is coming soon - It is nice if you can speak some English, but this is not obligatory 
 Sign up 
For this year's festival, Cinekid is looking for ten enthusiastic young people aged 14 and above. Do you want to be part of the most fun and largest film and media festival for children in the worl...

 - Onderzoek / Lector - Wo - 24 - 32 uur

 Working at THUAS has it! 
 Aan de slag bij De Haagse 
The Hague University of Applied Sciences (THUAS) is looking for a Researcher / PhD Candidate in agent-based modelling (ABM) on the circular economy . 
This is a 0.8 fte Researcher position at THUAS, with simultaneous enrolment as a PhD candidate at the Faculty of Technology, Policy and Management (TPM) of Delft University of Technology (TU Delft). 
About the position 
The candidate will be appointed for a 4-year period to research how to better understand and accelerate the circular economy. The focus is on developing a multi-level ABM that links micro-level consumer and organisational decisions to macro-level transition dynamics. Using inverse generative methods, the candidate will uncover which individual behaviours drive observed system-level transitions and build interactive policy dashboards to explore scenarios such as repair incentives and right-to-repair regulations. Case studies focus on e-bikes and washing machines. 
The position is embedded in CIVIC-4CE, a five-year NWO-funded consortium of universities, businesses, municipalities, and NGOs, and is conducted within THUAS's Centre of Expertise Digital Operations and Finance and the Faculty of Technology, Policy and Management (TPM ) at TU Delft. Wat vragen wij van jou? 
We are looking for a candidate with an MSc in Complex Systems Engineering and Management, Engineering and Policy Analysis, econometrics, industrial ecology, innovation management, mathematics, computer science, or an adjacent quantitative field. Affinity with simulation modelling or programming is required; ABM experience is a strong asset. The candidate should enjoy multidisciplinary settings, be able to work independently, and have strong written English skills. Some background in policy analysis, behaviour, or ...

As an Operational Purchasing Coordinator you ensure that the right materials are available at the right time. The suppliers have already been selected and the commercial agreements have been established; from that point onwards, you take operational responsibility for the purchasing process. You are the link between suppliers, planning, production and logistics. You monitor purchase orders and delivery times, actively manage suppliers and take action whenever risks arise that could impact production. In a dynamic high-tech manufacturing environment, priorities can change quickly. It is therefore important that you maintain an overview, anticipate potential issues and take ownership until a problem has been fully resolved. What will you do? Place, manage and monitor purchase orders for raw materials and components. Monitor delivery times and coordinate deliveries with production and factory planning. Act as the first operational point of contact for suppliers and hold them accountable for agreements and performance. Work closely with Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Logistics and other internal stakeholders. Make operational purchasing decisions based on lead times, costs and the total cost of a product or delivery. Identify risks, deviations and bottlenecks at an early stage and take ownership of resolving them. Investigate the root causes of recurring issues and contribute to structural improvements within purchasing and supply chain. Ensure accurate administration and reliable data in SAP/ERP systems. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A gross monthly salary between €3,300 and €5,200, excluding holiday allowance. 27 vacation days plus 13 ADV days. A good pension scheme and travel allowance. A personal development and growth plan. Plenty of opportunities to further develop your skills across different technical disciplines and projects. An innovative and entrepreneurial working environment within the high-tech manufacturing industry. Flexible working hours within a 24/7 productio

environment. Free lunch or dinner at the location. An iPhone, laptop and other tools you need to perform your job effectively. Free sport facilities. Functie-eisen A Bachelor's degree (HBO) in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a technical field. At least 3 years of experience in operational purchasing, procurement or supply chain coordination. Experience within a technical or manufacturing environment is a strong advantage. You take ownership and do not let go of an issue until it has been resolved. You are able to manage multiple and changing priorities while maintaining a clear overview. You communicate easily with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers. You have a good command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Experience with SAP or another ERP system is relevant for this position. Hier kom je te werken You will work in an innovative high-tech manufacturing environment in the Eindhoven region. The organization develops and manufactures complex technological solutions for various international markets, including the energy transition, healthcare, digitalization and industrial automation. Different disciplines work closely together within the organization. Engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and development form an integrated environment in which advanced technology is developed and brought from concept to series production.

jobs.description:
Your Key Contributions to Memorable Stays As a Doorman you are the first impression for our guests visiting the hotel. Therefore, it is important that you are always smiling to make sure that our guest feel immediately at home. Arriving guests are welcomed by you and directed to our reception desk for check in. You are responsible for the coordination of arriving and leaving guests as well as the coordination of taxis. In addition you make sure that our main entrance is always nice and tidy which gives our guest the best first impression.

In this position you are a part of our Front Office team. Our Doorman also assist with the rooming of our guests and taking care of our VIP's. Within this team you make sure that we give our guests a special and extraordinary stay. With your alert attitude you always know what is going on at the main entrance and lobby area and how to exceed the expectations of our guests.

Your Talent, Our Traditions of Excellence
